sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加利福尼亚州及全球各地合作创新，寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这全都是该大学致力于提升所有生物生活质量使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stcentury.ucdavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 请访问 21stcentury.ucdavis.edu 了解更多信息。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Two vast and trunkless legs of stone stand in the desert.
sentences.zh: 两只巨大的、没有躯干的石腿立在沙漠中。

sentences.en: In Ozymandias, the poem by Percy Shelley.
sentences.zh: 这是珀西·雪莱的诗作《奥齐曼迪亚斯》中的内容。

sentences.en: The poem is about a historic monument of a figure.
sentences.zh: 这首诗是关于一个历史人物的纪念碑。

sentences.en: A shattered visage lies.
sentences.zh: 一张破碎的面容躺在地上。

sentences.en: Who has a wrinkled lip and a sneer of cold command.
sentences.zh: 他有着微皱的嘴唇和冷酷傲慢的狞笑。

sentences.en: The statue points to all the works around him and the poem reads,
sentences.zh: 雕像指向他周围所有的作品，诗中写道，

sentences.en: My name is Ozymandias, King of Kings.
sentences.zh: 我是奥齐曼迪亚斯，万王之王。

sentences.en: King of Kings, look upon my works, ye mighty, and despair.
sentences.zh: 万王之王啊，看看我的功绩，强者们，绝望吧。

sentences.en: And the rest of the poem says that all of the works that the statue is pointing to have disappeared.
sentences.zh: 而诗的其余部分则说，雕像所指向的所有功绩都已消失不见。

sentences.en: Nothing beside remains.
sentences.zh: 四周空无一物。

sentences.en: So it's really a poem about that the figure remains, but everything around it has disappeared.
sentences.zh: 所以这实际上是一首关于人物本身尚存，但周围一切都已消失的诗。

sentences.en: Everything that the figure and the statue was supposed to be proud of.
sentences.zh: 曾经令该人物和这座雕像引以为豪的一切都消失了。

sentences.en: But this is about another former statue that once stood high above San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 但这讲的是另一座曾经高高耸立在旧金山上空的昔日雕像。

sentences.en: This is kind of the inverse.
sentences.zh: 这有点像是个反例。

sentences.en: All of the things around it, all of the landscape that this statue was supposed to sort of urge to liberty and philanthropy.
sentences.zh: 周围所有的事物，这座本该激发起人们对自由与慈善向往的雕像所处的风景。

sentences.en: That's all still here.
sentences.zh: 这一切都依然还在。

sentences.en: The San Francisco, the statue was dedicated to improving.
sentences.zh: 这座雕像旨在改善的旧金山。

sentences.en: Is there, but the statue itself has disappeared.
sentences.zh: 它还在，但雕像本身却消失了。

sentences.en: That's William Littman.
sentences.zh: 那是威廉·利特曼。

sentences.en: I teach architectural history at the California College of Art in Oakland and San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 我在奥克兰和旧金山的加州艺术学院教授建筑史。

sentences.en: And we're walking up to what I think may be the greatest place in all of San Francisco that few people have ever heard of on what was once considered the geographic center of the city.
sentences.zh: 我们正走向上我认为是旧金山最伟大、却鲜为人知的地方，这里曾被认为是该市的地理中心。

sentences.en: So here we come up.
sentences.zh: 所以我们上来了。

sentences.en: It's this kind of raised plinth.
sentences.zh: 这是一个类似高台基的地方。

sentences.en: On top of Mount Olympus.
sentences.zh: 在奥林匹斯山的山顶。

sentences.en: A massive stone pedestal that rises up to nothing.
sentences.zh: 一个巨大的石质底座，向上延伸却空无一物。

sentences.en: It's the base of a statue that isn't there.
sentences.zh: 这是一个已经不在了的雕像的基座。

sentences.en: Where once this 12-foot-high bronze statue stood on top of it.
sentences.zh: 曾经，一座12英尺高的青铜雕像就矗立在它的顶端。

sentences.en: On a site that has some of the best views of the entire city.
sentences.zh: 这个地方拥有全城最好的视野。

sentences.en: And the view is insane.
sentences.zh: 而且景色好得令人发指。

sentences.en: It's a 360 view of the city.
sentences.zh: 这是一个可以360度俯瞰城市的视角。

sentences.en: The statue was called the Triumph of Light.
sentences.zh: 这座雕像被称为《光明的胜利》。

sentences.en: It was a statue of this woman who looked a little like the Statue of Liberty.
sentences.zh: 那是一尊看起来有点像自由女神像的女性雕像。

sentences.en: She was holding aloft a giant torch.
sentences.zh: 她高举着一支巨大的火炬。

sentences.en: On the other hand, she had a piece of parchment.
sentences.zh: 而在另一只手里，她拿着一张羊皮纸。

sentences.en: And below her was a crouched figure kind of reaching up to these two objects.
sentences.zh: 在她下方是一个蜷缩的人物，似乎正伸手够着这两样东西。

sentences.en: As if it was symbolizing mankind reaching for light and liberty.
sentences.zh: 仿佛象征着人类对光明与自由的渴望。

sentences.en: It was erected in 1887 by then-developer and future mayor Adolf Sutro as a symbol of liberty and progressivism.
sentences.zh: 它由当时的开发商、后来的市长阿道夫·苏特罗于1887年竖立，作为自由与进步主义的象征。

sentences.en: When Sutro dedicated the statue in 1887 on Thanksgiving Day, he told the crowd,
sentences.zh: 1887年感恩节，苏特罗在为雕像举行落成典礼时对人群说，

sentences.en: May the light shine from the torch of the goddess of liberty to inspire our citizens to good and noble deeds for the benefit of mankind.
sentences.zh: 愿自由女神火炬的光芒闪耀，激励我们的公民为了人类的福祉做出善良而崇高的行为。

sentences.en: It was supposed to stand forever, to be a timeless reminder.
sentences.zh: 它本应永远屹立，成为一个永恒的提醒。

sentences.en: About the importance of liberty and civilization and philanthropy.
sentences.zh: 关于自由、文明和慈善的重要性。

sentences.en: But it didn't laSt.
sentences.zh: 但它并没有持久。

sentences.en: In the 1930s, people were referring to it as the mystery monument.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪30年代，人们开始称它为神秘纪念碑。

sentences.en: So obviously people have forgotten about Sutro and his goals.
sentences.zh: 显然，人们已经遗忘了苏特罗和他的目标。

sentences.en: And then by the 40s, there's discussion about removing it.
sentences.zh: 到了40年代，便有了将其拆除的讨论。

sentences.en: After decades of neglect, sometime in the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 经过几十年的忽视，大约在20世纪50年代。

sentences.en: It just disappears.
sentences.zh: 它就这样消失了。

sentences.en: And people discuss it online where it may have gone.
sentences.zh: 人们在网上讨论它究竟去了哪里。

sentences.en: So no one knows.
sentences.zh: 所以没有人知道。

sentences.en: People really do come up to this hill.
sentences.zh: 人们确实会来到这座小山。

sentences.en: The same things that drew Sutro here.
sentences.zh: 当年吸引苏特罗来到这里的那些事物。

sentences.en: Bring dog walkers and, you know, just urban walkers to come up here.
sentences.zh: 吸引着遛狗的人，还有，你知道的，就是来这儿散步的城市居民。

sentences.en: Or maybe through these kind of discussions, we can actually have someone maybe decide to build a new statue.
sentences.zh: 或者也许通过这些讨论，我们能让某人决定建造一座新雕像。

sentences.en: I mean, who knows what it would look like, though?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，谁知道它会是什么样子呢？

sentences.en: Imagine the debates about how would you symbolize liberty and philanthropy.
sentences.zh: 想象一下关于如何象征自由和慈善的辩论吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't know if I would like to see anything else here.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不知道我是不是还想在这里看到别的什么东西。

sentences.en: Does that make me weird?
sentences.zh: 这让我显得很奇怪吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I mean, that is...
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是……

sentences.en: Then what we should have here is a little plaque telling people that there was once this beautiful sculpture to light and liberty and philanthropy, and now it's gone.
sentences.zh: 那么我们这里应该立一块小牌子，告诉人们这里曾有过一座美丽的雕塑，献给光明、自由和慈善，而现在它没了。

sentences.en: So that's what we need to work on.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们需要努力的方向。

sentences.en: Although a sense of mystery is always good.
sentences.zh: 尽管某种神秘感总是好的。

sentences.en: You know, people look up and think, what could have been up there?
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们抬头看着，会想，上面曾经是什么呢？

sentences.en: What is missing?
sentences.zh: 缺少了什么呢？

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is about the stories of human-made objects.
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》讲述的是人造物的故事。

sentences.en: And maybe, in this case, the absence of the object makes for a better story.
sentences.zh: 也许在这个案例中，物品的缺席反而构成了更好的故事。

sentences.en: A monument to learning and light and liberty that's missing is almost a more amazing monument that says more about us.
sentences.zh: 一座关于学习、光明与自由的纪念碑的缺失，几乎是一座更惊人的纪念碑，它更能说明我们自己。

sentences.en: About just neglect and how a city forgets its paSt.
sentences.zh: 关于冷漠，以及一个城市如何遗忘它的过去。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced by me, Roman Mars, with support from Lunar.
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》由我罗曼·马尔斯制作，并得到了 Lunar 的支持。

sentences.en: It's a product of KALW, the American Institute of Architects, San Francisco, and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 它是 KALW、美国建筑师学会旧金山分会以及建筑与设计中心的联合出品。

sentences.en: Find out more and see pictures at 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 请访问 99percentinvisible.org 了解更多信息并查看图片。
